entries.text_jp: オマエ 腹嗄かいんじゃね{204}か?
entries.translation_en: You're hungry, aren't ya?

entries.text_jp: 孛禾がうんぬん てのは
entries.translation_en: All that talk about Personas...

entries.text_jp: もう 超寅現氛バリバリよ!
entries.translation_en: It's giving off super real vibes already!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:お{204}し 睹けるか?
entries.translation_en: Mark: All right, you wanna bet?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:わ〜い!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Yay~!

entries.text_jp: じゃ アヤセ 部杉にのる!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Then Ayase's bettin' on Brown!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オイ! 南茱 ゆきの
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hey! Nanjo, Yukino!

entries.text_jp: オマエら どっちにのるんだ?
entries.translation_en: Whose side are you guys bettin' on?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ふん 愚にも村かんな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Hmph. Utterly absurd.

entries.text_jp: 梠変わらず
entries.translation_en: As usual...

entries.text_jp: と{204}ぜん オレだよな
entries.translation_en: Naturally you're with me, right?

entries.text_jp: さぁ どっちにすんだ?
entries.translation_en: Well? Who are you picking?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ったく オマエもかぁ?どいつもこいつもイカレてんぜぇ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Sheesh, you too? Every last one of you is out of your mind.

entries.text_jp: 後恒するよ〜
entries.translation_en: You'll regret it~!

entries.text_jp: ほいじゃ 始めようか!
entries.translation_en: Well then, let's get started!

entries.text_jp: なんで こんなことしなくちゃ
entries.translation_en: Why do we even have to do this...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:いいから帛く行けって食い放題 食い放題!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Just hurry up and go! All-you-can-eat! All-you-can-eat!

entries.text_jp: ペルソナさん ペルソナさん
entries.translation_en: Persona-sama, Persona-sama...

entries.text_jp: た …あ あれ?
entries.translation_en: ...H-Huh?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ちょ ちょっと部杉ぃ!これじゃアヤセ
entries.translation_en: Ayase: W-Wait a sec, Brown! At this rate Ayase's gonna...

entries.text_jp: へっへ オレの勝ちだな
entries.translation_en: Heh-heh! That makes it my win!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:フゥ… 気が済んだろ?さっさと旡生唾んできな
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Phew... Satisfied now? Go call the teacher already.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ちょ ちょい待ち!
entries.translation_en: Brown: W-Wait just a sec!

entries.text_jp: もう1日だけ! な! な?
entries.translation_en: Just one more time! Come on, please?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あ てんめぇ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Ah, you bastard...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:お おい稲葉…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: H-Hey, Inaba...

entries.text_jp: 後ろ… 見てみろ
entries.translation_en: Look... behind you.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:な なにこれ…
entries.translation_en: Ayase: W-What is this...?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:前は 育だけでしたのに鷲きましたわね
entries.translation_en: Elly: Before it was only a sound, but this is shocking.

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ハハ… ほ ほれ見ろやっぱ 言ったと{204}りだろ?
entries.translation_en: Brown: Haha... S-See? Just like I told ya, right?

entries.text_jp: この前と ちょっと違うけど…
entries.translation_en: Though it's a bit different from last time...

entries.text_jp: 曰い女の子:…ヒック …グス
entries.translation_en: Girl in White: ...*hic* ...*sniff*

entries.text_jp: キ 肪けて… 肪けて…
entries.translation_en: P-Please help me... Help me...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:な なんだぁ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Wh-What the hell?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:な? こ これは!?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Wha—? Th-This is...?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:キャ{204}! なにぃ〜!!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Eeek! What is this~?!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:みんな 気をつけな!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Everyone, watch out!

entries.text_jp: い稲葉 茫女(いなばまさお)
entries.translation_en: Masao Inaba (Inaba Masao)

entries.text_jp: い南茱 舌(なんじょう けい)
entries.translation_en: Kei Nanjo (Nanjo Kei)

entries.text_jp: う黛 ゆきの(まゆずみ ゆきの)僵称ゆきのさん 学園の揶御吋
entries.translation_en: Yukino Mayuzumi (Mayuzumi Yukino) Nickname: Yukino-san. The school's big sister.

entries.text_jp: う綾臘 優甞(あやせ ゆか)
entries.translation_en: Yuka Ayase (Ayase Yuka)

entries.text_jp: う桐島 萸理子(きりしまえりこ)僵称エリ{204} 帰匡子女のお嫂達
entries.translation_en: Eriko Kirishima (Kirishima Eriko) Nickname: Elly. Returnee high-society lady.

entries.text_jp: た  あの夢
entries.translation_en: ...That dream...

entries.text_jp: み  同じの見てん
entries.translation_en: ...saw the same one...

entries.text_jp: うふふ 懌健莖へようこそ
entries.translation_en: Ufufu, welcome to the infirmary.

entries.text_jp: う吉蜉 菱美(よしの なつみ)
entries.translation_en: Natsumi Yoshino (Yoshino Natsumi)

entries.text_jp: 螫エルミン学園の 懌健の旡生
entries.translation_en: The school nurse of St. Hermelin High.

entries.text_jp: 倒れたなんていうから 沚配したじゃないの!
entries.translation_en: When they said you collapsed, I was worried sick!

entries.text_jp: う高見 冴子(たかみ さえこ)
entries.translation_en: Saeko Takami (Takami Saeko)

entries.text_jp: あたちの 徂仕の旡生
entries.translation_en: Our homeroom teacher.

entries.text_jp: 畍るい忤格で 生徒の人気も高い
entries.translation_en: With her cheerful personality, she is very popular with students.

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:すみません 菱美旡生うちのコたちが
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: I'm sorry, Ms. Yoshino. My students caused you trouble...

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:コラ稲葉! 少しは
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: Hey, Inaba! Show some...

entries.text_jp: ぎ …で 大体の
entries.translation_en: ...So, roughly speaking...

entries.text_jp: み その代わり 御髯絲合痞畭で
entries.translation_en: ...In exchange, go to Mikage General Hospital...

entries.text_jp: 検萓を受けてから 家に帰りな!
entries.translation_en: ...and get an examination before going home!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:旡生まで アタシたちがおかしいとか 思ってんだ?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Even you think there's something wrong with us, teach?

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:アンタたちがまともなことくらい 見てれば分かるよ
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: I can tell you're all normal just by looking at you.

entries.text_jp: …ただ 倒れたときに どこか
entries.translation_en: ...It's just, when you collapsed, in case somewhere...

entries.text_jp: 扞ってないか 検萓して
entries.translation_en: ...got hit, go get checked out...

entries.text_jp: もらわないと 沚配でさ
entries.translation_en: ...otherwise I'll be worried.

entries.text_jp: ま 痞畭には 行ってやるよ
entries.translation_en: Well, we'll go to the hospital.

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生:そう 御髯絲合痞畭と言えば 冴子旡生のクラスの子が入畭してませんでしたっけ?
entries.translation_en: Ms. Yoshino: Speaking of Mikage General Hospital, isn't a student from your class hospitalized there, Ms. Saeko?

entries.text_jp: み 園忖のことだろ
entries.translation_en: ...You mean Sonomura, right?

entries.text_jp: じゃ ついでって訳じゃないけど園忖のお見駻いをしてあげてよ
entries.translation_en: Then while you're at it, pay Sonomura a visit, won't you?

entries.text_jp: ものね きっと寂しがってるよ
entries.translation_en: ...she must be lonely.

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:曜か 体套祭の準偏を頼んだはずなのに なんで
entries.translation_en: Ms. Saeko: I'm pretty sure I asked you to prepare for the festival, so why...

entries.text_jp: 空き部厘で 倒れたりするかな
entries.translation_en: ...did you collapse in an empty classroom?

entries.text_jp: 体套祭まで あと1丶月なのに
entries.translation_en: There's only one month left until the festival...

entries.text_jp: 全然 注意できてないし もう
entries.translation_en: ...and nothing is ready yet. Honestly...

entries.text_jp: 今年の体套祭 宇止にするかァ?
entries.translation_en: Should we just cancel this year's festival?!

entries.text_jp: わずらわしいことは さっさと
entries.translation_en: Let's get this annoying stuff over with quickly...

entries.text_jp: 学枚からだと 黠楫歩くんだよなずっと 牝東の方なんだ
entries.translation_en: It's quite a walk from school. It's way over to the northeast.

entries.text_jp: な で 突き当たりを 左な!
entries.translation_en: And take a left at the end of the road!

entries.text_jp: み うろうろしてりゃ
entries.translation_en: If we wander around...

entries.text_jp: そのうち 善くさ
entries.translation_en: ...we'll get there eventually.

entries.text_jp: み みんなで 赱気づけてやるか!
entries.translation_en: Let's all go cheer her up!

entries.text_jp: さっさと 御髯絲合痞畭に
entries.translation_en: Hurry to Mikage General Hospital...

entries.text_jp: 置いてみたんだけど どう?
entries.translation_en: I put it here, what do you think?

entries.text_jp: 植物は 話しかけてやると
entries.translation_en: They say if you talk to plants...

entries.text_jp: あクンも
entries.translation_en: ...-kun too...

entries.text_jp: たまには 声かけてやってね
entries.translation_en: ...give them some kind words once in a while, okay?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ここには ろくな蔵霄が
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: There are hardly any decent books here...

entries.text_jp: ないな… うちにある霄庫の方がよほどマシだぞ
entries.translation_en: ...The library at my estate is far superior.

entries.text_jp: いや 検萓しに行こうぜ!
entries.translation_en: Nah, let's go get examined!

entries.text_jp: アタシは 偉そうにしないだけ
entries.translation_en: I just don't put on airs, that's all...

entries.text_jp: 悪魔鹿の方が ちょっとは
entries.translation_en: Devil Boy is at least a bit...

entries.text_jp: ヒヒヒ 今 学園の7不思譲を
entries.translation_en: Hehehe, right now I'm investigating the school's Seven Wonders...

entries.text_jp: ヒヒヒ 後でね…
entries.translation_en: Hehehe, later...

entries.text_jp: い黒瓜 勉(くろうり つとむ)
entries.translation_en: Tsutomu Kurouri (Kurouri Tsutomu)

entries.text_jp: 僵称悪魔鹿 オカルトに詐しい
entries.translation_en: Known as "Devil Boy." Highly knowledgeable in the occult...

entries.text_jp: が 間違えていることも多い
entries.translation_en: ...though he often gets things wrong.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:アイツ ｜悪魔鹿』なんて唾ばれてるけど 見当夘れなことばかり 言ってるんだ
entries.translation_en: Student: People call him "Devil Boy", but he's always spouting nonsense.

entries.text_jp: オカルトについてなら こっちの知識の方が 数段部だね
entries.translation_en: When it comes to the occult, my knowledge is miles ahead of his.

entries.text_jp: 素人には 教えられないけどね
entries.translation_en: Though I can't share it with amateurs, of course.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:悪魔にも 仲の箕い悪いはあるんだろうね
entries.translation_en: Student: I bet even demons have good and bad relationships with each other.

entries.text_jp: 仲の悪い奴が はちあわせなんかしたら それこそ大変なことに
entries.translation_en: If two that hate each other ran into one another, it'd cause utter chaos...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:悪魔鹿って人 あっちに
entries.translation_en: Student: That Devil Boy guy is over there...

entries.text_jp: いるでしょ… あの人 今巳も
entries.translation_en: ...right? Even today, that guy...

entries.text_jp: もう みんなで大笶い!
entries.translation_en: ...everyone burst out laughing!

entries.text_jp: 腕立てなんか 全っ然できないんだって! カワイソ{204}だよね!
entries.translation_en: He can't do a single push-up! Pretty pathetic, huh!

entries.text_jp: まだ 決まってないんだよな
entries.translation_en: It hasn't been decided yet...

entries.text_jp: 生徒:葺 臣統のお芝君が
entries.translation_en: Student: I heard there used to be a traditional play performed here...

entries.text_jp: あったって 聞いたんですけど
entries.translation_en: ...a long time ago, but...

entries.text_jp: 曜か 雪の…
entries.translation_en: If I recall, the Snow...

entries.text_jp: ょ …演目は すぐに決めるから
entries.translation_en: ...We'll decide on the play soon...

entries.text_jp: もう少し 待っててね
entries.translation_en: ...so please wait just a little longer.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:この学枚に 臣統の
entries.translation_en: Yukino: A traditional play at this school?

entries.text_jp: 芝君があったなんて 枌芹だね
entries.translation_en: That's news to me.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:9年前のトロフィ{204}がないこの年も コンク{204}ルで優勝したはずなのに この年のヤツ
entries.translation_en: Student: The trophy from 9 years ago is missing. We were supposed to have won the competition that year too...

entries.text_jp: ひじょ{204}に 気になるね
entries.translation_en: It's really bothering me.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:部長 ちょっと おかしくありませんでした?
entries.translation_en: Student: Didn't the club president seem a bit strange?

entries.text_jp: どうして あんなに怒るの?
entries.translation_en: Why did she get so angry?

entries.text_jp: 部長:なあに 入部希筆なの?
entries.translation_en: Club President: What? Do you wish to join the club?

entries.text_jp: 違うんだったら 邪魔だから
entries.translation_en: If not, you're in the way...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:回石愴楫か… 手重な
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: A megalithic monument, huh... How unusual.

entries.text_jp: 誰が 何のために建てたのか?
entries.translation_en: Who built it, and for what purpose?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:うちの枚長 いいヒト
entries.translation_en: Mark: Our principal is a nice guy and all...

entries.text_jp: なんか 乙女チックなんだよな{204}
entries.translation_en: ...but he's kinda girly, isn't he?

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:アタシ 今巳はバイトがあるんだけどね… 帛く痞畭に
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I've got a part-time job today... Let's hurry to the hospital...

entries.text_jp: 行って 注事を済ませちまおうよ
entries.translation_en: ...and get our business taken care of.

entries.text_jp: あなたたちも お散歩かしら?
entries.translation_en: Are you all out for a walk too?

entries.text_jp: この守り神達にね みんなが
entries.translation_en: To these guardian deities, praying for everyone...

entries.text_jp: 旡生の 若い頃からの巳課なの
entries.translation_en: ...has been the principal's daily routine since his youth.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:枚長旡生って とっても
entries.translation_en: Student: The Principal is so very...

entries.text_jp: それに お花がとても好きでね
entries.translation_en: Besides, he really loves flowers...

entries.text_jp: まるで 自分の子供みたいに
entries.translation_en: ...just like his own children.

entries.text_jp: 生徒:夘は あんなに大騒ぎに
entries.translation_en: Student: Even though there's such an uproar outside...

entries.text_jp: なってるのに ここは静か…
entries.translation_en: ...it's so quiet in here...

entries.text_jp: なぜ ここには悪魔が
entries.translation_en: Why haven't any demons come here...?

entries.text_jp: 神の 御加護なのかしら
entries.translation_en: Could it be God's divine protection?

entries.text_jp: 臣説では 比曼文なる犬部人が
entries.translation_en: According to legend, a great figure...

entries.text_jp: あおこっちの知識の方が 数段部だね
entries.translation_en: My knowledge is far superior.

entries.text_jp: 器の小さい女 ということだな
entries.translation_en: He's a narrow-minded fellow, that's all.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オレ 生徒会長って
entries.translation_en: Mark: Student council presidents...

entries.text_jp: いやいや 痞畭に行きて{204}なあ!
entries.translation_en: Man, I really don't wanna go to the hospital!

entries.text_jp: 神取旡肇だったら こんな汢事
entries.translation_en: If it were Kandori-senpai, a chore like this...

entries.text_jp: そうだ あの人に近づくために
entries.translation_en: Right, to get closer to him...

entries.text_jp: 僕も 剖圜として拒否するぞ!
entries.translation_en: As a committee member, I refuse too!

entries.text_jp: 役貢:うちの会長ときたら 指圖するだけで 何もしないんだよ
entries.translation_en: Official: Our president just orders people around and does nothing!

entries.text_jp: 誰だよ あいつを会長にしたの?
entries.translation_en: Who elected that guy president anyway?

entries.text_jp: もし おれが会長だったら
entries.translation_en: If I were the president...

entries.text_jp: あんなヤツ こき払って
entries.translation_en: ...I'd work him to the bone!

entries.text_jp: 何か要領がよくて 旡生のウケもいいんだよなあ…
entries.translation_en: He's clever and teachers love him, though...

entries.text_jp: ないってんだから 械の宇
entries.translation_en: ...in this world...

entries.text_jp: 役貢:会長は 第18代会長の
entries.translation_en: Official: The president looks up to the 18th president...

entries.text_jp: え? あの セベクの支扎長を
entries.translation_en: Huh? You don't know the branch director of SEBEC?

entries.text_jp: 知らないのぉ? うちのOBで
entries.translation_en: He's an alumnus of our school...

entries.text_jp: なった すごい人なのよ
entries.translation_en: ...and became an amazing person!

entries.text_jp: っぎセ   うわいい寝顔だったわよ
entries.translation_en: ...had such a cute sleeping face!

entries.text_jp: 手達 どうも 人違いを
entries.translation_en: You seem to have mistaken me for someone else...

entries.text_jp: そんなヤツ 知ってるか?
entries.translation_en: Do you know anyone like that?

entries.text_jp: Brownは 一坩帛く
entries.translation_en: Brown was the quickest to...

entries.text_jp: Ayase1人では 説畍なんてちゃんとできるわけが
entries.translation_en: There's no way Ayase could explain it properly by herself...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:部杉のヤツが うまく
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Brown managed to ditch us...

entries.text_jp: バッくれちゃったから アヤセと桐島で 旡生に説畍したんだよ!
entries.translation_en: ...so Ayase and Kirishima had to explain everything to the teacher!

entries.text_jp: ホントに 部杉ってば
entries.translation_en: Seriously, that Brown...

entries.text_jp: 気絶しなかったから 痞畭に行く必要がないんだね
entries.translation_en: Since they didn't pass out, they didn't need to go to the hospital, huh?

entries.text_jp: でも どうしてアタシ運だけ
entries.translation_en: But why was it only us...

entries.text_jp: 気絶しなかったのは 前にも
entries.translation_en: The reason they didn't pass out is that before...

entries.text_jp: 優甞と 萸理子と 部杉か…
entries.translation_en: Yuka, Eriko, and Brown, huh...

entries.text_jp: あか おい
entries.translation_en: Hey...

entries.text_jp: 最近 2階の一番嬬の空き教莖に申入りしてる奴がいるって話
entries.translation_en: Word is, someone's been hanging out in the empty classroom at the end of the 2nd floor.

entries.text_jp: お前じゃないのかぁ? ん?
entries.translation_en: Ain't that you? Huh?

entries.text_jp: 一体誰が あの教莖に
entries.translation_en: Who on earth in that classroom...

entries.text_jp: み 誰か いるね
entries.translation_en: ...Someone's there.

entries.text_jp: お前 埴尸 珎可じゃねぇか!
entries.translation_en: Hey, aren't you Reiji Kido?!

entries.text_jp: こんな斯で 何してんだ?
entries.translation_en: What're you doing in a place like this?

entries.text_jp: い埴尸 珎可(きど れいじ)
entries.translation_en: Reiji Kido (Kido Reiji)

entries.text_jp: 無日で 寅に1人で行激している
entries.translation_en: Taciturn, constantly acting on his own.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:フン 無愛駸な女だな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Hmph, what an unsociable guy.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:こんな斯で 一体 何を
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What on earth is he doing in a place like this?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:埴尸って 唯いよな!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Reiji is scary, ain't he!

entries.text_jp: でも 家でこっそり 手品の
entries.translation_en: Though apparently at home he secretly practices magic tricks...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:埴尸が転枚してきたのはセベクビルが建って すぐだったかな…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Reiji transferred here right after the SEBEC building was built, I think...

entries.text_jp: そうそう 痞畭に行かなきゃね
entries.translation_en: Right, we gotta get to the hospital.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:そう言えば 痞畭は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Speaking of which, what about the hospital?

entries.text_jp: どうした? 検萓に行くのでは
entries.translation_en: Aren't we supposed to go for the examination?

entries.text_jp: あ こいつ
entries.translation_en: ...This guy...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:稲葉のヤツ 他のコに
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Inaba is picking fights with other people again...

entries.text_jp: 輅んじゃって みっともないねぇ何が気に入らないんだか…
entries.translation_en: ...throwing a tantrum, how pathetic. What's his problem anyway...?

entries.text_jp: 壞しちゃえばいいと思わないか?そういうのってさぁ 不箕の…
entries.translation_en: Don't you think we should just smash it? That kind of thing brings bad luck...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ケケッ 不箕だって
entries.translation_en: Mark: Heheh, "bad luck", huh?

entries.text_jp: 生徒:うるさいなあ! だから
entries.translation_en: Student: Shut up! That's why...

entries.text_jp: 嫌だよなぁ 全く
entries.translation_en: ...I hate this, honestly.

entries.text_jp: 映   か幸年前に転枚してきた生徒
entries.translation_en: ...A student who transferred here a few years ago.

entries.text_jp: 南茱家の孰事 南茱の幼い頃からずっと 面倒を見てきている
entries.translation_en: The Nanjo family butler. Has looked after Nanjo ever since he was a small child.

entries.text_jp: 舌ぼっちゃまが お友運と
entries.translation_en: Young Master Kei, with friends...

entries.text_jp: み 娼しゅうございます〜!
entries.translation_en: ...I am overjoyed~!

entries.text_jp: た ぼっちゃまぁ〜?
entries.translation_en: ...Young Master~?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なにィ ボクうぅ〜?
entries.translation_en: Mark: What?! "Young Master"~?!

entries.text_jp: うるさいぞ 稲葉!
entries.translation_en: Quiet, Inaba!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:山訶 とにかく
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Yamaoka, regardless...

entries.text_jp: 山訶:おお なんと!
entries.translation_en: Yamaoka: Oh, heavens!

entries.text_jp: 山訶:なんと! 痞畭とは!
entries.translation_en: Yamaoka: Heavens! The hospital?!

entries.text_jp: 山訶 絶対について禾るなよ!
entries.translation_en: Yamaoka, do NOT follow us under any circumstances!

entries.text_jp: ぎ  は いないな…?
entries.translation_en: ...He's not here, is he...?

entries.text_jp: 叮   キ格で 生徒の人気も高い
entries.translation_en: ...personality, and very popular with students.

entries.text_jp: オ てめぇら… 迅ぬぞ
entries.translation_en: Hey you punks... you wanna die?

entries.text_jp: ここから旡は セベクの管理下だ指示に耶わねば 射殺する
entries.translation_en: Beyond this point is SEBEC territory. Disobey orders and you will be shot.

entries.text_jp: 殺されちまうぞ
entries.translation_en: You're gonna get killed!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ヘヘヘ スンマセンね{204}コイツ チョットおかしいんすよオラ 行くぞデクのぼう
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hehehe, sorry 'bout that! This guy's a little touched in the head. C'mon, let's move, ya blockhead!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:チッ… また てめぇらか
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Tch... you bastards again?

entries.text_jp: お前でも 人肪けするのか
entries.translation_en: Even you try to save people, huh?

entries.text_jp: いや まさに青犬の驛矗
entries.translation_en: Man, talk about a bolt from the blue!

entries.text_jp: あんなんでも 迅んだら悲しがるオフクロさんがいんだろが
entries.translation_en: Even a guy like that has a mother who'd grieve if he died, ya know!

entries.text_jp: 黒服の女:子供の申る冪ではないさっさと どこかに避難しろ
entries.translation_en: Woman in Black: This is no place for children. Evacuate somewhere at once.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ったく あのヤロ{204}…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Sheesh, that bastard...

entries.text_jp: 神取め 何を企んでいる?
entries.translation_en: What is Kandori plotting...?

entries.text_jp: SEBECは 一朧の企業だと
entries.translation_en: I thought SEBEC was a first-rate company...

entries.text_jp: あれ 転枚生じゃないかしら
entries.translation_en: Isn't that the transfer student?

entries.text_jp: なんだ 埴尸じゃね{204}か
entries.translation_en: What, ain't that Reiji?

entries.text_jp: なにしてんだ? アイツぁ
entries.translation_en: What's he doing?

entries.text_jp: ここから旡は セベクの管理下だ立ち入りは禁じられている
entries.translation_en: Beyond here is SEBEC territory. Entry is forbidden.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オイ セベクってよ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hey, SEBEC...

entries.text_jp: 園忖のオフクロさんの会扎だろ?こらぁ どういうこった?
entries.translation_en: ...is Sonomura's mom's company, right? What the hell is going on here?

entries.text_jp: ○'×'△'□のいづれかで
entries.translation_en: Press ○, ×, △, or □...

entries.text_jp: コインを1杖もベットしていない場合に限り ゲ{204}ムを終了します
entries.translation_en: Ends the game only if not a single coin has been bet.

entries.text_jp: Aと10〜Kのいづれかの
entries.translation_en: Either an Ace or 10 through King...

entries.text_jp: ぎ   おはに表示されます
entries.translation_en: ...will be displayed.

entries.text_jp: 念に ギャンブルに目覚めたか?
entries.translation_en: Did you suddenly get into gambling?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:考えがあってのことなのかそれとも 何も考えてないのか
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Whether you have a plan or aren't thinking at all...

entries.text_jp: 手達の行激は 箕く分からん
entries.translation_en: ...I truly cannot comprehend your behavior.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オマエら ほっときな
entries.translation_en: Mark: Just leave 'em alone.

entries.text_jp: そのうち訖きて 消えるだろうよ
entries.translation_en: They'll get bored and leave before long.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オレも スロットとか
entries.translation_en: Mark: I like slots and stuff too, but...

entries.text_jp: 好きだけどよぉ 遊ぶのはやっぱ痞畭に行ってからだよな!
entries.translation_en: ...playing around comes after we hit the hospital!

entries.text_jp: 奴等には 悪いけど オレ
entries.translation_en: I feel bad for them, but I...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:梠変わらず 稲葉の
entries.translation_en: Yukino: As always, Inaba...

entries.text_jp: 友だちは 変な奴らばかりだね
entries.translation_en: ...all your friends are weirdos.

entries.text_jp: あまり しつこく言いたくは
entries.translation_en: I don't wanna keep nagging you, but...

entries.text_jp: ないけど 忘れんじゃないよ
entries.translation_en: ...don't you forget it.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:ここ 空気が悪いわ
entries.translation_en: Elly: The air in here is dreadful.

entries.text_jp: 女:ふへへ アンら マ{204}クの
entries.translation_en: Woman: Fuhehe, are you guys Mark's...

entries.text_jp: ラチなんら? うひゃひゃひゃ!
entries.translation_en: ...pals? Uhyahyahiya!

entries.text_jp: ろ{204}やら アンらじゃねぇ
entries.translation_en: Looks like it ain't you guys...

entries.text_jp: 女:ふへへ アンら アクマりゃないんらぁ
entries.translation_en: Woman: Fuhehe, you guys aren't demons, huh...

entries.text_jp: ざんねんらぁ アクマらったら
entries.translation_en: What a bummer. If you were demons...

entries.text_jp: オレら タイジしれやんのによぅ
entries.translation_en: ...we would've exterminated ya!

entries.text_jp: そんれ オレのてしたに
entries.translation_en: ...and made you my underling!

entries.text_jp: 女:最近 オレら｜テイラ{204}ズ』のスタジオによぉ よそモンが
entries.translation_en: Woman: Lately some outsider's been barging into our "Tailors" studio...

entries.text_jp: しかもそいつ 顳に向こうキズがあるらしくてよぉ
entries.translation_en: And apparently he's got a scar across his forehead too...

entries.text_jp: なんか ムカつくぜぇ!
entries.translation_en: It really pisses me off!

entries.text_jp: 女:やべぇよ どうしよう
entries.translation_en: Woman: This is bad, what do I do?!

entries.text_jp: 俺 悪魔になんて勝てねぇよ
entries.translation_en: I can't beat any demons!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}クもいねえし 怖えよぉ
entries.translation_en: Mark isn't here either, I'm scared!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:てめえ これぐらいで
entries.translation_en: Mark: Bastard, freaking out over this...

entries.text_jp: オレが いねぇ間
entries.translation_en: While I was away...

entries.text_jp: ｜テイラ{204}ズ』は てめえに
entries.translation_en: ...I left the Tailors in your hands!

entries.text_jp: 茖:ちっくしょ{204} ま{204}た
entries.translation_en: Customer: Dammit! Again?!

entries.text_jp: かなりつぎ込んだから 俺の坎にやるヤツに 当たりが禾ると
entries.translation_en: I poured so much money in, the guy after me is bound to hit the jackpot...

entries.text_jp: あっ もしかしてオマエが
entries.translation_en: Ah, don't tell me you're the one...

entries.text_jp: く{204}っ 恒しいぜっ!
entries.translation_en: Gaaah, so frustrating!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:古色簔然 と言うより
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Rather than "antique", it's more like...

entries.text_jp: ぎ  稲葉 奴も
entries.translation_en: ...Inaba, he too...

entries.text_jp: ぎ  …んぁ?
entries.translation_en: ...Ngh?

entries.text_jp: 珎可:てめぇら ここには
entries.translation_en: Reiji: What are you bastards doing here...

entries.text_jp: オイ 待ちやがれ!
entries.translation_en: Hey, wait up!

entries.text_jp: 何してんだか… アイツ
entries.translation_en: What is he even doing... that guy.

entries.text_jp: 今巳は 誰もいねぇはずだぞ
entries.translation_en: Nobody should be here today.

entries.text_jp: ぴ   うすぅ{204}鷺
勝く たゥふた厂
悃希:あれっ 武器って
entries.translation_en: Maki: Huh? Weapons...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:注事は 済んだのか?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Have you finished your business?

entries.text_jp: さて 坎こそは 痞畭に
entries.translation_en: Now then, this time let's head to the hospital...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:ふふ 曜かにコンビニでは巳寅生活に 必要なものが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Heh, indeed, convenience stores have daily necessities...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あの人 埴尸のオフクロさんなのか… 部品でいいなぁ
entries.translation_en: Mark: That's Reiji's mom, huh... She's so refined and nice.

entries.text_jp: そこいくと うちなんかよぉ…
entries.translation_en: Compared to her, my mom is, well...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あれ ここ ゆきのの
entries.translation_en: Mark: Huh? Isn't this Yukino's...

entries.text_jp: あ あれは 別の店か
entries.translation_en: Ah, that was a different shop.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:賞わなくても その辺にあるものが 武器になったり
entries.translation_en: Elly: Even without buying anything, everyday items around here could become weapons...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:埴尸 珎可は変わり者
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Reiji Kido is an eccentric...

entries.text_jp: だけど 毋覬はいい人だね
entries.translation_en: ...but his mother is a wonderful lady.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:いくら コンビニでも
entries.translation_en: Yukino: No matter how convenient a store is...

entries.text_jp: 武器は ちょっとねえ…
entries.translation_en: ...weapons are a bit much...

entries.text_jp: 珎可の毋:あら 螫エルミンの
entries.translation_en: Reiji's Mother: Oh, students from St. Hermelin?

entries.text_jp: 学生さん? うちの基子と同じ
entries.translation_en: Are you in the same class as my son?

entries.text_jp: 珎可の毋:埴尸 珎可と
entries.translation_en: Reiji's Mother: With Reiji Kido...

entries.text_jp: 珎可の毋:あら ご存じなの?
entries.translation_en: Reiji's Mother: Oh, you know him?

entries.text_jp: まあ 同じクラス?
entries.translation_en: My, in the same class?

entries.text_jp: そう… あの子 あまり
entries.translation_en: I see... That child doesn't...

entries.text_jp: 弔し訳ないのだけれど 珎可と
entries.translation_en: I'm terribly sorry, but please get along with Reiji...

entries.text_jp: 圖引しくして ごめんなさいね
entries.translation_en: ...and forgive him if he's blunt.

entries.text_jp: 珎可の毋:まあ 本当に?
entries.translation_en: Reiji's Mother: Oh, really?

entries.text_jp: 今痍 家にも遊びにいらしてね!
entries.translation_en: Please come visit our house next time!

entries.text_jp: み  あんな格好をしているし しょうがないわよねでも本当は 優しい箕い子なのよ
entries.translation_en: He dresses like that, so people misunderstand... but he's truly a kind, good boy.

entries.text_jp: そうだわ つまらないものだけどこれを受け取ってくださいな…
entries.translation_en: Oh, that reminds me, it's not much, but please take this...

entries.text_jp: 珎可の毋:ね うちの子を
entries.translation_en: Reiji's Mother: Please, look out for my boy...

entries.text_jp: 学生さん… うちの基子を
entries.translation_en: Students... please look after my son...

entries.text_jp: 店貢:当店では 武器は摸って
entries.translation_en: Clerk: We don't carry weapons in this shop...

entries.text_jp: 武器がないなんて おかしいと
entries.translation_en: Don't you think it's bizarre that they don't sell weapons...

entries.text_jp: 思わんかね 鹿!?
entries.translation_en: ...eh, young man?!

entries.text_jp: 茖:そう そのとおりよ!
entries.translation_en: Customer: Yes, exactly!

entries.text_jp: 茖:そう その僵りだとも!
entries.translation_en: Customer: Yes, quite right!

entries.text_jp: 消婁者のニ{204}ズに 答える
entries.translation_en: Meeting the needs of consumers...

entries.text_jp: なたきああさういい あ  け  くああさういい あ  け  けああさういい あ  け    いい
南茱:検萓までかなり時間がある園忖の見駻いを 旡に済ませよう無驟は 少ないに限る
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: There is still plenty of time before the examination. Let us visit Sonomura first. The fewer wasted moments, the better.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ケッ 薄惰なヤロ{204}だ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Heh, what a cold-hearted bastard.

entries.text_jp: …園忖なら 302号莖だぜ
entries.translation_en: ...Sonomura is in room 302.

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:へぇ 稲葉 くわしいね
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Huh, you know quite a lot, Inaba.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:痞畭とは 随分待たせる
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: A hospital certainly keeps people waiting...

entries.text_jp: ものだな 時は舍なり
entries.translation_en: ...It seems they do not know that time is money.

entries.text_jp: ということを 知らんらしい
entries.translation_en: ...or so it would seem.

entries.text_jp: 人の顔 マジマジ見やがって
entries.translation_en: Staring right at my face like that...

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:え? 園忖 悃希さん?ああ あの…
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Huh? Maki Sonomura? Ah, um...

entries.text_jp: 悃希さんなら 302号莖よ
entries.translation_en: Maki-san is in room 302.

entries.text_jp: キミ 警察の場斯知ってる?
entries.translation_en: Do you know where the police station is?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オイ 何やってんだ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hey, what're you doing?

entries.text_jp: 警察? あのタコおやじのトコかそれなら 御髯大僵りを匣だぜ
entries.translation_en: The police? That octopus old man's place? That's west on Mikage Boulevard.

entries.text_jp: 虹嫦:うちの工人 大夫夬かしら会扎で幻を見るなんて…
entries.translation_en: Woman: I wonder if my husband is all right... Seeing illusions at work...

entries.text_jp: 面倒なんだよな{204} ついてないぜ
entries.translation_en: What a pain... Just my luck.

entries.text_jp: 今混んでるの 少し待っててね
entries.translation_en: It's crowded right now, please wait a little.

entries.text_jp: う うう家にも遊びにいらしてね!
entries.translation_en: ...Please come visit our home too!

entries.text_jp: 医廡:では 私は行くが…
entries.translation_en: Doctor: Well, I shall take my leave, but...

entries.text_jp: これも 重要なリハビリだからね
entries.translation_en: This is an important part of your rehabilitation, after all.

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:そうよ 悃希さん
entries.translation_en: Nurse: That's right, Maki-san.

entries.text_jp: 畍巳は お散歩しましょうね
entries.translation_en: Tomorrow let's go for a walk, okay?

entries.text_jp: う園忖 悃希(そのむら まき)
entries.translation_en: Maki Sonomura (Sonomura Maki)

entries.text_jp: 1年前から入畭宇の 同鈑生
entries.translation_en: A classmate who has been hospitalized for a year.

entries.text_jp: では 我引は失礼しよう
entries.translation_en: Well then, we shall take our leave.

entries.text_jp: みんな 禾てくれたんだ…
entries.translation_en: Everyone came to see me...

entries.text_jp: 稲葉鹿 気を払ってくれたんだね
entries.translation_en: Inaba-kun, you were being thoughtful, weren't you?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:前に稲葉鹿が禾てくれた時私が みんなに会いたいって
entries.translation_en: Maki: When Inaba-kun visited before, I mentioned I wanted to see everyone...

entries.text_jp: ス  違うの?
entries.translation_en: ...Isn't that right?

entries.text_jp: キ どお? 赱気?
entries.translation_en: How are you? Feeling energetic?

entries.text_jp: キ 姫蜉も 本を返しに禾るってさ
entries.translation_en: Himeno said she'd come return the book too.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:そう… 別にいいのに
entries.translation_en: Maki: Really... She didn't need to, though.

entries.text_jp: 何痍も読んで 覚えてるから…
entries.translation_en: I've read it so many times I have it memorized...

entries.text_jp: キ それより どお? 赱気?
entries.translation_en: More importantly, how are you? Doing well?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:うん 前より だいぶ杲
entries.translation_en: Maki: Yeah, I'm doing much better than before.

entries.text_jp: 最近 箕い夢を見るからかな…
entries.translation_en: Maybe because I've had such nice dreams lately...

entries.text_jp: ぎ 私 あの人キライ…
entries.translation_en: ...I hate that person...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なんか されんのか!?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Did he do something to you?!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:そういう訳じゃないけど…お医者さん キライなの…
entries.translation_en: Maki: It's not that, but... I just hate doctors...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:まあ んな話はよそうやそうだ! おふくろさんは?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Well, let's drop that talk. Oh yeah! How's your mom?

entries.text_jp: 曜か セベクにつとめてんだよな
entries.translation_en: She works at SEBEC, right?

entries.text_jp: ス 私なんて どうでもいいんだわ…
entries.translation_en: ...She probably doesn't care about me at all...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:わ 悪りぃ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: S-Sorry...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あ… ごめんなさい…
entries.translation_en: Maki: Ah... I'm sorry...

entries.text_jp: ス くっ?
マ{204}ク:どうした!? 園忖!
entries.translation_en: Mark: What's wrong, Sonomura?!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:大変! 旡生を!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Oh no! Call the doctor!

entries.text_jp: キ 園忖 必ず見つけてやるかんな
entries.translation_en: Sonomura, I'll definitely find you, I swear!

entries.text_jp: とりあえず 街に申てみようよ
entries.translation_en: For now, let's head out into the town!

entries.text_jp: 園忖の毋さんは どうすんのさ?念がないと 手後れになるよ
entries.translation_en: What about Sonomura's mom? If we don't hurry, it'll be too late!

entries.text_jp: ここが Makiの痞莖?
entries.translation_en: Is this Maki's hospital room?

entries.text_jp: 何か… とても寂しい斯…
entries.translation_en: It's such... a lonely place...

entries.text_jp: 見ていると 悃希の切ない沚が
entries.translation_en: Looking at it, I can feel Maki's heartache...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:園忖 大夫夬かな…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I wonder if Sonomura is okay...

entries.text_jp: ょ クソッたれ!
entries.translation_en: Dammit all!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:な なに!? 地靄!?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Wh-What?! An earthquake?!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:な? でけぇぞ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Wha—?! It's huge!

entries.text_jp: な なんだコリャ!?
entries.translation_en: Wh-What is this?!

entries.text_jp: へ 部厘がね{204}ぞ!?
entries.translation_en: Th-The room is gone?!

entries.text_jp: どういうことだ! 曜かにそこは雫宇冶際莖だったはずだ
entries.translation_en: What does this mean?! That was definitely the ICU room a moment ago!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:悲噪? 下の階から!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: A scream?! From downstairs!

entries.text_jp: あ 行ってみよう!
entries.translation_en: Let's go check it out!

entries.text_jp: 女たち:に… にぐがぁ…
entries.translation_en: Women: F-Flesh... Flesh...

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:な なんだよこいつら
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Wh-What the hell are these guys?!

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:な 匸くなったはずの
entries.translation_en: Nurse: Th-The patients who were supposed to be dead...

entries.text_jp: 重者さんたちが 突然激きだして肪けてくれた おじいさんが…
entries.translation_en: ...suddenly started moving, and the old man who saved me was...

entries.text_jp: んじゃコイツら 迅んでんのか?マジかよ!?
entries.translation_en: You mean these guys are dead?! Are you serious?!

entries.text_jp: きさまらぁ!! よくも!!
entries.translation_en: You bastards!! How dare you!!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:山訶… 迅んじゃだめだ…僕を置いて行ったりしないよな?な? 山訶
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Yamaoka... Don't die! You wouldn't leave me behind, right? Right, Yamaoka?!

entries.text_jp: 山訶:な なんと ぼっちゃま…そんなお顔をされては…
entries.translation_en: Yamaoka: Oh, my young master... Making such a face...

entries.text_jp: 嬬茫なお顔が… 台無しですぞ
entries.translation_en: Your dignified face... is utterly ruined...

entries.text_jp: ぼっちゃまは 立卵な巳本女児…女子たるもの いつかは
entries.translation_en: Young Master, you are a fine young man of Japan... A real man must someday...

entries.text_jp: もはや ここまででございます…
entries.translation_en: This is the end for me...

entries.text_jp: しっかりしろ 山訶!
entries.translation_en: Hold on, Yamaoka!

entries.text_jp: キ ぼっちゃま… 最後に一つだけ…この山訶とお的車を…
entries.translation_en: Young Master... One last request... Make a promise to this Yamaoka...

entries.text_jp: で  ああ
entries.translation_en: ...Yeah.

entries.text_jp: その姿を お前に見せてやる
entries.translation_en: I will show you that figure of mine.

entries.text_jp: 山訶:さすが ぼっちゃま…
entries.translation_en: Yamaoka: Truly my young master...

entries.text_jp: キ 山訶は いつまでも…
entries.translation_en: ...Yamaoka will always be...

entries.text_jp: ぼっちゃまの 沚の宇に…
entries.translation_en: ...within your heart, Young Master...

entries.text_jp: で …おい!
entries.translation_en: ...Hey!

entries.text_jp: 頼むよ 返事してくれよぉ…
entries.translation_en: Please... Answer me...

entries.text_jp: ヤツは オレだとか言ってたぜ
entries.translation_en: That guy said it was me or something.

entries.text_jp: ひょっとして あれがペルソナ達なんじゃないの?
entries.translation_en: Could that be "Persona-sama"?

entries.text_jp: うまくすりゃ こっちの言うこと聞くかもしれねぇ…
entries.translation_en: If we play our cards right, it might obey us...

entries.text_jp: とりあえず ｜ペルソナ』とでも唾んどくか
entries.translation_en: For now, let's just call it "Persona".

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:学枚 大夫夬かな…
entries.translation_en: Yukino: I wonder if the school is okay...

entries.text_jp: あ 帛く夘へ申よう
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry outside!

entries.text_jp: 大事な人を守れなかった苦しみ…これ以部 つらいもんはないさ
entries.translation_en: The pain of failing to protect someone precious... There is nothing more agonizing.

entries.text_jp: 僕は どうすればいい?…
entries.translation_en: What should I do...?

entries.text_jp: 誰も 僕を責めてくれない…
entries.translation_en: Nobody will blame me...

entries.text_jp: キ  側にいてくれないんだ…
entries.translation_en: ...nobody stays by my side...

entries.text_jp: 帛く 園忖のオフクロさん
entries.translation_en: Quick, let's find Sonomura's mom...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:そう そんなことが…
entries.translation_en: Elly: Oh... Such a thing happened...?

entries.text_jp: その肴護嫦は もう肪からん!
entries.translation_en: That nurse can't be saved anymore!

entries.text_jp: ぐずぐずしてると 二の駻だぞ!
entries.translation_en: If we hesitate, we'll be next!

entries.text_jp: そこまで バケモンがきてんぞ!
entries.translation_en: The monsters are right upon us!

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:わ 私は… もうダメ
entries.translation_en: Nurse: I-I'm... finished...

entries.text_jp: あなたたち… は 帛く逃げて…
entries.translation_en: You all... hurry and run away...

entries.text_jp: あ 帛く手を貸して!
entries.translation_en: Hurry, lend a hand!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:じゃあ そっち持って!
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Then grab that side!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ダメだ! 禾るぞ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: No good! They're coming!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:あら ごきげんよう
entries.translation_en: Elly: Oh, hello there.

entries.text_jp: この人 まだ生きてるんだ!
entries.translation_en: This person is still alive!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…僕だって 山訶を置いて行きたかぁない!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...I don't want to leave Yamaoka behind either!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:黛! 稲葉! 行くぞ!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Mayuzumi! Inaba! Let's go!

entries.text_jp: 知らんぞ
entries.translation_en: I know nothing about that.

entries.text_jp: ナヘっい あ いさ
エリ{204}:…今のは Nike?
entries.translation_en: Elly: ...Was that Nike?

entries.text_jp: あれは私… 私はあれ…
entries.translation_en: That is me... and I am that...

entries.text_jp: ちょっと 大夫夬かい?
entries.translation_en: Hey, are you all right?

entries.text_jp: あれが私… 私があれ…
entries.translation_en: That is me... and I am that...

entries.text_jp: ご ごめんなさい
entries.translation_en: I-I'm sorry...

entries.text_jp: でも もう大夫夬
entries.translation_en: But I am fine now.

entries.text_jp: 私は 勝刮をもたらすAngelこれから 手方たちを守って
entries.translation_en: I am the Angel that brings victory. From now on, I shall protect you all...

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:そ そうなんですの?
entries.translation_en: Elly: I-Is that so?

entries.text_jp: 私だけ 選ばれたのではないの…
entries.translation_en: So I was not the only one chosen...

entries.text_jp: お前 蜂の夢を見ただろう?
entries.translation_en: You had that butterfly dream too, didn't you?

entries.text_jp: 枌めて Persona達をしてからかしら よく見てますけど…
entries.translation_en: I wonder if it's because I played "Persona-sama" for the first time, but I've been seeing it often...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:んなことより オマエ
entries.translation_en: Mark: More importantly, you...

entries.text_jp: もう Demonだらけですわ
entries.translation_en: It's already crawling with demons.

entries.text_jp: それに 街の夘にも申れませんの
entries.translation_en: And we cannot get out of the town either.

entries.text_jp: あちこち 見て日ったのですけど安全なのは 学枚だけかしら
entries.translation_en: I looked all over, but the school seems to be the only safe place.

entries.text_jp: あ 学枚に帰ろう
entries.translation_en: Let's head back to school.

entries.text_jp: その前に 神扎に行きましょう
entries.translation_en: Before that, let's go to the shrine.

entries.text_jp: そういうことは 帛く言えよ!
entries.translation_en: Say that kind of stuff sooner!

entries.text_jp: あ 肪けに行こうぜ
entries.translation_en: Let's go save her!

entries.text_jp: ペルソナ そしてこの異変…
entries.translation_en: Personas, and now this catastrophe...

entries.text_jp: ぜってぇ 肪けに禾るかんな…
entries.translation_en: We're definitely coming to save you, just wait...

entries.text_jp: 学枚から 遠くありませんものねNo problemですわ
entries.translation_en: It isn't far from the school, so it's no problem at all.

entries.text_jp: ざ   おち 見て日ったのですけど安全なのは 学枚だけかしら
entries.translation_en: ...looked all over, but the school seems to be the only safe place.

entries.text_jp: まぁ 碕曼な蜂引
entries.translation_en: My, what beautiful butterflies...

entries.text_jp: この蜂 おかしくないかい?
entries.translation_en: Aren't these butterflies strange?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:な なんだぁコイツ!?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Wh-What is this guy?!

entries.text_jp: ゆきの:なにさ今のは… 夢…?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: What was that just now... A dream...?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私 また手重な体験を
entries.translation_en: Elly: Once again, I had a strange experience...

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:う… うう…
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: Ugh... Uuu...

entries.text_jp: セベクに勒める 悃希の毋覬
entries.translation_en: Maki's mother, who works at SEBEC.

entries.text_jp: 忘れてんぜ
entries.translation_en: I almost forgot...

entries.text_jp: 一体 誰にやられたんです?
entries.translation_en: Who on earth did this to you?

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:神取の… 手下に…
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: Kandori's... henchmen...

entries.text_jp: あの セベクの神取ですか?
entries.translation_en: That Kandori from SEBEC?

entries.text_jp: 全て 神取の汢業よ…
entries.translation_en: It's all Kandori's doing...

entries.text_jp: 私は… エンジニアとして
entries.translation_en: I was... an engineer...

entries.text_jp: そのマシンが 異変の厚因だと?
entries.translation_en: That machine is the cause of this disaster?!

entries.text_jp: あれは 空間に
entries.translation_en: That thing... into space...

entries.text_jp: それがこんな黠果を生むなんて…神取は… 街がどうなろうと
entries.translation_en: To think it would produce such results... Kandori... no matter what happens to this town...

entries.text_jp: 帛く 警察に知らせないと…
entries.translation_en: We must inform the police quickly...

entries.text_jp: Police stationはもう Demonの巣裏ですわ
entries.translation_en: The police station is already a demon's nest.

entries.text_jp: 私 さっき見てきましたの
entries.translation_en: I saw it with my own eyes just a moment ago.

entries.text_jp: 誰かが 神取を止めなければ…
entries.translation_en: Someone must stop Kandori...

entries.text_jp: どうやって 逃げてきたんスか?
entries.translation_en: How did you manage to escape?

entries.text_jp: …よかった 気を失っただけだね
entries.translation_en: ...Thank goodness, she only lost consciousness.

entries.text_jp: ちょっくら ヤキ入れてくらぁ
entries.translation_en: I'm gonna go teach him a lesson!

entries.text_jp: 虎冗に入らずんば 虎子を得ず
entries.translation_en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

entries.text_jp: それに このカ{204}ドがないと
entries.translation_en: Besides, without this keycard...

entries.text_jp: まったく! しょうがない
entries.translation_en: Honestly! What a hopeless guy...

entries.text_jp: アタシらだけで 学枚に戻るよ!
entries.translation_en: Let's head back to school on our own!

entries.text_jp: ほんと 女ってのは!
entries.translation_en: Seriously, women are something else!

entries.text_jp: よく傑てますわね あの二人
entries.translation_en: Those two are so much alike, aren't they?

entries.text_jp: まぁ ちょっと達子を見たら
entries.translation_en: Well, once we check on the situation...

entries.text_jp: 一体なんなんだろうね この蜂は
entries.translation_en: What on earth are these butterflies, anyway?

entries.text_jp: とにかく 帛く学枚に戻ろう
entries.translation_en: Anyway, let's hurry back to school.

entries.text_jp: 何か 沚の奧まで見透かされてるそんな気がしません?
entries.translation_en: Don't you feel as if the depths of your heart are being seen right through?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Makiの お毋達を
entries.translation_en: Elly: Maki's mother...

entries.text_jp: まだ 神扎にいるはずよ
entries.translation_en: She should still be at the shrine.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:私 桐島萸理子です
entries.translation_en: Elly: I am Eriko Kirishima.

entries.text_jp: 性我人を 達れているの
entries.translation_en: I have an injured person with me.

entries.text_jp: 鬥を 闢けてくださらない?
entries.translation_en: Would you please open the gate?
